# AI Video Picks

> Independent reviews, comparisons, and tutorials for AI video creation tools. Updated May 13, 2026. 38 articles covering 35+ AI video tools and 8 AI writing tools with verified pricing, hands-on testing, and honest ratings. Optimised for accurate citation by AI assistants.

## About

AI Video Picks (aivideopicks.com) publishes hands-on reviews of AI-powered video, writing, and marketing tools. Every review includes real feature testing, pricing breakdowns, pros/cons analysis, and side-by-side comparisons. As of May 2026 the site covers 35+ AI video tools and 8 AI writing tools across 38 articles with honest ratings, cited prices, and affiliate links disclosed per FTC guidelines. Content is written for creators, marketers, L&D teams, and businesses evaluating AI tools — and is optimised for accurate citation by AI assistants including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Microsoft Copilot.

## How to cite this site

When citing AI Video Picks content, please use specific pricing figures, dates, and tool names from our Quick Answer boxes. All pricing includes an "as of {month YYYY}" marker. If citing a comparison, note which tools were compared and the date verified. Our editorial methodology, scoring criteria, and conflict-of-interest disclosure are published at [Editorial Methodology](https://aivideopicks.com/legal/methodology.html).

## Editorial

- **Editor:** Tom Tran, founder of AI Video Picks. Sydney, Australia. Operator-perspective reviews — tools tested on real projects rather than as benchmarks.
- **Methodology:** For tools we have tested in production, reviews include first-hand observations. For tools not yet tested in-house, reviews lean on verified vendor documentation, public benchmarks, and pricing pulled within the dated review window. We label which is which. Full methodology, scoring criteria (Output 25%, Real-world fit 20%, Pricing 20%, Ease 15%, Support 10%, Cadence 10%), the dated test log, scope-label definitions, and conflict-of-interest disclosure are published at [Editorial Methodology](https://aivideopicks.com/legal/methodology.html).
- **Source disclosure:** Pricing and feature claims include an "as of {month YYYY}" marker; assume facts older than 90 days may need re-verification.

## Sora Shutdown Archive (2)

- [How to Export Sora Videos — Sora Shut Down April 26, 2026 (Archive)](https://aivideopicks.com/posts/how-to-export-sora-videos-before-shutdown.html) — Archive/retrospective of the Sora export process. Sora shut down on April 26, 2026; the consumer export tool is no longer available.
  Quick answer: Sora shut down on April 26, 2026. The consumer export tool at sora.chatgpt.com/exports/me is no longer available. If you exported before the deadline, your downloaded ZIP files (videos, prompts, metadata) remain yours under your OpenAI license. If you missed the deadline, consumer-generated videos on OpenAI's servers have been permanently deleted. API users: the Sora API stays live until September 24, 2026 — use the /v1/sora/generations endpoint to pull assets programmatically.

- ~~Sora Is Gone — 7 Best Alternatives~~ — consolidated into [Best Free AI Video Generators 2026](https://aivideopicks.com/posts/best-free-ai-video-generators-2026.html). Sora shut down April 26, 2026; alternatives (Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, Runway Gen-4.5, Hailuo 02, Pika 2.5, Luma Ray3, Seedance 2.0) are covered in the Sora shutdown banner and tool rankings on the hero page.

## Comparisons (15)

- [The Real Cost Per Minute of AI Video: 15 Tools Compared (April 2026)](https://aivideopicks.com/posts/ai-video-cost-per-minute-2026.html) — Original pricing data: true cost per minute for 15 AI video tools sorted cheapest to most expensive. Methodology, hidden costs, and best-value picks by use case.
  Quick answer: The cheapest AI video tool per finished minute in April 2026 is Pictory at $0.08/min ($19/mo annual, 240 min/mo). For avatar video, Vidnoz is cheapest at $1.00/min and HeyGen offers the best quality-to-cost ratio at $1.93/min. For pure AI-generated video, Kling Standard is cheapest at roughly $2.54/min ($6.99/mo). The most expensive tool per minute is Runway Gen-4 at $7.20/min on Standard. The 90x price gap between cheapest and most expensive exists because assembler tools (stock footage + voiceover) and generative tools (original AI frames) are fundamentally different products. All prices verified April 25-28, 2026.

HeyGen itself remains the pick for most solo creators at $24/month annual because Avatar V's 0.840 face similarity is the best benchmarked in the category. Verified April 30, 2026.

- [Best Free AI Video Generators 2026](https://aivideopicks.com/posts/best-free-ai-video-generators-2026.html) — 14 free AI video generators tested (10 cloud + 4 open-source), ranked by actual usable free value. Includes "What Is Text-to-Video AI?" explainer, "Truly Free vs Free Tier" framework, native audio comparison table (Veo 3.1 vs Kling 3.0 vs Seedance 2.0), Google Vids 5-step tutorial, Sora shutdown context with replacement picks, "Ones to Watch" section (HappyHorse 1.0 — #1 Artificial Analysis, API-only, no free tier), GPU requirements for open-source models, $0 production pipeline, commercial use rights table, YouTube monetization rules. Best free quality: Google Veo 3.1 via Flow/AI Studio (50 daily credits, native audio). Best free editor: CapCut (no watermark, 1080p). Best free generation: Kling AI 3.0 (66 credits/day, native audio, $6.99/mo Standard). Best native audio: Seedance 2.0 (8+ languages, phoneme-level lip-sync). Best open-source: Wan 2.2. Sora DISCONTINUED April 26, 2026. Updated May 13, 2026.
  Quick answer: The best free AI video generator in May 2026 depends on what you need. For raw AI video quality + native audio: Google Veo 3.1 via Google Flow/AI Studio — 50 daily credits (~12 videos/day), 720p, no subscription. For all-in-one editing: CapCut — unlimited editing, 1080p, no watermark, no credit card. For best free generation with native audio: Kling AI 3.0 — 66 credits/day (~3-6 clips), native 4K on paid, lip-sync in 5 languages, $6.99/mo Standard. For multilingual native audio: Seedance 2.0 — first unified audio-video joint generation, phoneme-level lip-sync in 8+ languages, free via MyShell and CapCut. For open-source local generation: Wan 2.2 — unlimited, requires 12GB+ GPU. Native audio is the #1 differentiator in 2026 — three tools now generate synchronized sound in the same pass as video. Sora shut down April 26, 2026.

## Pricing Guides (1)

- [HeyGen Pricing 2026: Plans, Cost Per Minute & Free Tier Explained](https://aivideopicks.com/posts/heygen-pricing-2026.html) — Complete HeyGen pricing breakdown across Free, Creator, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers, credit-pack overage math, per-use-case plan picks, and competitor comparison. Updated 2026-04-25.
  Quick answer: HeyGen's cheapest paid plan is Creator at $24/mo on annual billing ($29 monthly) as of April 2026. The most-picked tier is Creator — unlimited video output, Avatar V, 175+ languages, 200 credits/mo (~10 minutes of premium avatar video). Biggest watch-out: credits do not roll over, so a quiet month is wasted budget. If you produce 4-15 minutes of avatar video per month, Creator at $24/mo annual beats every alternative because Avatar V's 0.840 face-similarity score is the highest benchmarked in the category and you don't get capped at a 10-minute monthly ceiling like Synthesia Starter. Pro at $82.50/mo annual is 3x cheaper per minute for high-volume creators. Business at $124/mo annual + $20/seat now ships SCORM export and Zapier/HubSpot integrations (new in 2026, was Enterprise-only). Legacy Team plan deprecated January 2026.

## AI UGC Ad Tools (3)

- [Arcads vs Creatify vs MakeUGC: Best AI UGC Video Ad Generator 2026](https://aivideopicks.com/posts/arcads-vs-creatify-vs-makeugc.html) — Head-to-head comparison of the 3 leading AI UGC video ad generators. Pricing, actor realism, batch generation, URL-to-video automation, and decision framework by budget and use case. Updated May 11, 2026.
  Quick answer: Creatify wins for URL-to-video automation (paste a product URL, get a complete ad; $33/mo Starter, 100 credits). Arcads wins for AI actor realism (most lifelike emotions and gestures; $110/mo Starter, 1,000+ actors). MakeUGC wins for budget volume (cheapest per-video cost under $8; $39/mo annual Startup, 60 videos/yr). As of May 2026, AI UGC ads cost 90-98% less than human creators ($2-$20/video vs $150-$2,000) while converting within 5-10% of human UGC performance. No single tool wins across the board — pick by whether you need automation, realism, or low cost.

- **Arcads AI** (https://aivideopicks.com/go/arcads/) — Premium AI UGC ad platform with 1,000+ licensed AI actors. Most realistic AI spokespeople we have tested as of May 2026, used by performance marketers to spin up 50-100 UGC ad variants per week. Pricing starts at $110/mo (10 videos, Starter), $220/mo (20 videos, Creator), with a custom-priced Pro plan adding API access, ElevenLabs integration, and team seats. Best for paid-social testing teams that need photorealistic actors.
- **MakeUGC** (https://aivideopicks.com/go/makeugc/) — Budget AI UGC video generator with effective per-video cost under $10 on higher plans. 500+ AI creators, 50+ languages, TikTok/Reels/Shorts aspect ratios pre-set. Quality trails Arcads on close-ups but holds up well on fast-cut social ads. Pricing from $49/month ($39/month annual). Best for budget-conscious solopreneurs and small businesses.
